entities.summary: Alon Abisola Arisicate Ajoke Olajuwon, better known as Abi Olajuwon is a Nigerian-American basketball coach and former player. She is an assistant coach for Connecticut Sun in the WNBA. Olajuwon is the daughter of former NBA center Hakeem Olajuwon. Her name, Abisola Olajuwon, means "born into wealth and loved by all".
